Cafetière

A dedicated appliance installed in the aircraft galley to brew hot coffee for passengers and crew. Its operation is subject to galley power availability and is monitored for safety.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Cafetière?

In this glossary, Cafetière refers to: A dedicated appliance installed in the aircraft galley to brew hot coffee for passengers and crew. Its operation is subject to galley power availability and is monitored for safety.

How is Cafetière used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Équipage, veuillez vérifier que la cafetière fonctionne correctement avant le service des boissons."

Definition
